instruction.text: Wähle die Bilder in der Reihenfolge aus, in der sie besprochen werden.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f1In'>It's honestly my dream to work from home.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_2025'>To me, it's really important that my job fits my active lifestyle.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m14Us'>Unfortunately, a lot of internships mean unpaid work.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f4_2025'>I admire my mother's commitment to her work.</voice>

instruction.text: Wo hörst du diesen Satz? Wähle aus.

atoms.a: Sometimes it takes quite a while until you hear back from a company.

atoms.a: I will apply for my dream job next spring.

b.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2_2025'>I will apply for my dream job next spring.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2_2025'>I will apply for my dream job next winter.</voice>

atoms.a: I'd rather be a full-time dad than work full-time.

b.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m3_2025'>I'd rather be a full-time dad than work full-time.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m3_2025'>I'd rather be a full-time dad than work part-time.</voice>

atoms.a: I would never want to work from home, I want to spend time with colleagues.

<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m4_2025'>I would never want to work from home, I want to spend time with co-workers.</voice>

atoms.a: My priority is to have a healthy work-life balance.

b.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m6_chirp'>My priority is to have a healthy work-life balance.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m6_chirp'>My priority is to have a healthy sleep-life balance.</voice>

atoms.a: I will study medicine so that I can become a doctor.

b.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m3_chirp'>I will study medicine so that I can become a doctor.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m3_chirp'>I will study medicine so that I can hopefully become a doctor.</voice>

atoms.a: Hopefully, I will be able to fulfil my dream of becoming a scientist.

b.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_chirp'>Hopefully, I will be able to fulfil my dream of becoming a scientist.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_chirp'>Hopefully, I will be able to fulfil my dream of being a scientist.</voice>

atoms.a: I hope my next placement will help me figure out what job I want to do in the future.

b.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f2_chirp'>I hope my next placement will help me figure out what job I want to do in the future.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f2_chirp'>I hope my next placement will help me decide what job I want to do in the future.</voice>

instruction.text: Welches Wort kommt nicht vor? Wähle es aus.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m10'>Placement is more commonly used in British English, while internship is used in both British and American English.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f2Us'>What the British call CV, we Americans call résumé.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f16Us'>It's difficult to decide if you want a career or a family first.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f13Us_chirp'>Not everyone I know has a dream job.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m15Us_chirp'>I'm not sure in which area I would like to work.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m13Us'>I have just been invited to my first job interview.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f7Us'>My mum says your CV is the most important document when applying for a job.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m12Us_chirp'>Always make sure you know where all of your certificates are.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m11Us'>To me, it feels like the job market is really hard to enter at the moment.</voice>
<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f2Us'>I wonder which jobs will stay secure in the future.</voice>
